head_commit.message:
Stage pipelines (cache, parallel), Dockerfile.ci, tia.toml, durations snapshot, ADR-0006

- ci-cache.yml: stage 1, dependency + Playwright + Docker layer caches
- ci-parallel.yml: stage 2, DAG + shardkit duration-balanced shards
- apps/*/Dockerfile.ci: dependency-first layer ordering (baseline Dockerfiles untouched)
- tia.toml: test impact analysis config for the three apps
- shardkit: use suite time when it includes class setup
- experiments/durations: per-unit durations from baseline run 40209104348

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
